cards.text: Right before this, Israel has been plundered and looted, and the LORD has poured out His anger on them for not walking in His ways (Isaiah 42:22-25). Then the prophet Isaiah brings the LORD's next message, and it opens with two of the best words you'll ever hear after a rough chapter: "But now." The LORD speaks to His people, calling them Jacob and Israel, as the One who created them and formed them.

cards.question: After all that fire and plunder, what's the first thing the LORD tells Israel?

cards.text: And He tells them why: "I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!" The Millers carved my name into my handle and STILL slid me into the junk drawer, so trust me, friend, being called by name AND claimed hits different.
Next the LORD brings up waters, rivers and fire. Friend, that's not a vacation itinerary, that's an obstacle course.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD promises His people they will never have to go through waters or fire.

cards.text: Here's the promise: the LORD will be with them in the waters, the rivers won't overwhelm them, and the flames won't set them ablaze. I've watched a late timer scorch a whole batch in ninety seconds, and these folks walk THROUGH the fire and don't even get scorched!

cards.question: Why can Israel count on getting through the waters and the fire?

answers.text: The LORD is their God and Savior

cards.text: God gives Himself three titles right there: the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. Then He names a ransom, Egypt, Cush and Seba in Israel's place, and friend, that is NOT pocket change.

cards.question: God gives Egypt, Cush and Seba in Israel's place because Israel is ___ in His sight.
True or false: God says He will give men in exchange for Israel because He loves them.

cards.text: Then the comfort comes back around: don't be afraid, God tells them, because He is with them. And He starts talking about gathering His people.

cards.question: True or false: God says He will gather His people from only one direction.

cards.text: He'll bring them from the east, gather them from the west, and tell the north, "Give them up!" and the south, "Do not hold them back!" Friend, that's not a "whenever you get a chance" text, that's a "pull up, I'm outside" text.

cards.question: God wants His people brought from afar and from the ends of the earth. What does He call them?
God wants everyone called by His name brought in. What does He say about each of them?

cards.text: Every one of them, created for His glory. Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer thinking I was made for the dust.
Now the scene shifts, and I think it feels like a courtroom. The call goes out: "Bring out a people who have eyes but are blind, and who have ears but are deaf."
All the nations gather together, and the peoples assemble. Then comes the challenge: who among them can declare this and proclaim the former things?

cards.question: The nations are challenged to proclaim the former things. What are they told to bring to back themselves up?

cards.text: The witnesses are there so others will hear and say, "It is true." I shared a drawer with an expired coupon that swore it was still good, and believe me, friend, NOBODY ever said "It is true."

cards.question: The nations are told to bring their witnesses. Then the LORD names His own witnesses. Who are they?

cards.text: And the LORD names one more alongside them: "My servant whom I have chosen." Chosen, friend, not left over at the bottom of a bin.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD wants His witnesses to believe Him and understand who He is.

cards.text: Then the LORD brings up every other god out there. Lean in, friend, because this is where it gets good.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says other gods were formed before Him.

cards.text: "Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come." I got swapped out for a shiny new stamper, but there is NO new model coming for God, friend: no upgrade, no replacement, NONE.

cards.question: God says, "I, yes I, am the LORD," and that there is no ___ but Him.

cards.text: Then comes a record: decreed, saved, proclaimed. That's not a résumé, friend, that's a highlight reel.

cards.question: Decreed, saved and proclaimed. Who does God say did all of that?

cards.text: Then that line comes back: "So you are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "that I am God." He goes back to eternity, and friend, I only go back to a 25-cent bin.

cards.question: True or false: God says no one can deliver out of His hand.
God ends with a question: "When I act, who can reverse it?" What answer is His whole message pointing to?

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 6 quotes "My servant whom I have chosen.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The correct answer, 'He formed and made them,' has already been given away by stop 1, card 1, which says the LORD created and formed His people. 'Created' and 'made' convey the same idea here, so the earlier card supplies the substance of the answer.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: Calling the chosen servant 'one more alongside them' presents the servant as an additional party distinct from the LORD's people. Isaiah 43:10 does not establish that distinction rather than describing the same people further, so the card settles a connection the text leaves open.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
